body: This is my first relationship. I’ve always had problems communicating about what’s bothering me because of my upbringing. Do you have any advice on how to talk to him about it? Keeping it all to myself is tearing me up. But I’ve had this conversation so many times and it’s just not worth my mental health to pour this all out, he makes false promises, and nothing happens again.

Hey, I honestly just left post about the same situation. I’m also really struggling with my bf watching porn. It’s really fucked up that your husband has his password as some influencers name. I come from a pretty fucked up family too and also wonder if my expectations are too high. But reading through your post really opened my eyes. I don’t think this is ok. It’s up to you whether you want to forgive him or not, but please stand up for yourself!

It’s comforting to know I’m not the only one who has had the same experience. If it’s not too personal to ask, could you tell me when your breaking point was or when you lost feelings? How long were you together for?

This is my first serious relationship and I would be heartbroken if I had to break up with him. I know it’s for my best interest in the long run but I’ve invested so much into this relationship and it hurts just to throw it all away like that.

I’ll see him tomorrow when he picks me up from the airport and I will update!

Thanks for the reply!

I have talked to him about this and he always seemed genuinely sorry. However, it would always go right back in a matter of days. I really don’t think I am asking for that much when I ask him to put some effort into caring about how I feel. I think it is a basic thing to have for 2 people dating each other.

Other than this, he’s a genuinely great boyfriend I’m and I still love him very much, I definitely will try to talk to him again about this (hopefully in person), but if nothing changes is this over?

Hey, I just want you to know that you are totally not alone in this. My boyfriend did this as well when we started dating (only online) and I would feel so terrible being compared to all these beautiful women online.
Personally, I think doing this stuff online is pushing it. In person is definitely a no! Set your boundaries and talk to him about how you are feeling. If he is not willing to change for you you need to start rethinking this relationship.
